name: draft-one
description: Modern Windows Proxy Client with v2rayN-style Route Editor and Clash Verge UI
author: draft-one

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:node && pnpm run typecheck:web
scripts.test: pnpm run typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types --test test/unit-test.mjs test/src-modules.test.mjs test/windows-hardening.test.mjs
scripts.build:pack: npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/build-incremental.mjs
scripts.build:win: pnpm run prepare:binaries && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.build:release: pnpm run prepare:binaries && npm run build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never && node scripts/build-incremental.mjs
